supported_checks.label_excerpt: Detailed examination for conjunctival tumor in right eye
supported_checks.source_quote: was referred to our department for a detailed examination.

supported_checks.label_excerpt: Conjunctival tumor resection and amnion transplantation
supported_checks.source_quote: he underwent conjunctival tumor resection and amnion transplantation without mitomycin C in his right eye.
supported_checks.explanation: The stated reason is a source-supported procedure, although admission itself is not explicitly established.

supported_checks.label_excerpt: Complete and rapid regression of the scleral melting after 2 weeks
supported_checks.source_quote: After 2 weeks, there was complete and rapid regression of the scleral melting
supported_checks.explanation: The reported response and timing are supported.

findings.label_excerpt: Urgent scleral patch transplant surgery and free conjunctival autograft transplantation
findings.source_quote: preparing for an urgent scleral patch transplant surgery. The peripheral conjunctiva contact with the melting site was removed, and free conjunctival autograft transplantation was also performed.
findings.explanation: The note says the patch transplant was being prepared for, but does not say it was performed; only the free conjunctival autograft is explicitly reported as performed. Listing the patch transplant as a surgery overstates its status.

findings.source_quote: The postoperative course had been good until a scleral ulcer emerged at a nasal ischemic necrotizing lesion 4 months later
findings.explanation: Four months anchors the ulcer emergence and postoperative examination, not the patch transplant. The patch transplant is described only as being prepared for, so this assigns a procedure timing not established by the note.

initial.summary: The label is mostly supported, but it states an urgent scleral patch transplant as performed and assigns it a time that the note does not establish.
